measures.zh: 综合智力：知识、推理、数学、编程混在一起的总分
measures.en: General intelligence: knowledge, reasoning, math and coding rolled into one number

explainer.zh: Artificial Analysis 是一家独立评测机构。它用同一套流程自己跑十余项公开评测（知识问答、科学推理、数学竞赛题、编程题、终端任务等），再把成绩加权合成一个 0–100 的指数。数字越高，模型的总体水平越强。它适合快速回答“这个模型大概处在什么位置”，但看不出某项具体能力的强弱。同一模型的不同推理强度（low / high / max）会被当作不同条目分别计分。
explainer.en: Artificial Analysis is an independent evaluator. It runs a dozen public evaluations itself under one harness (knowledge Q&A, scientific reasoning, competition math, coding, terminal tasks) and blends the results into a single 0–100 index. Higher means stronger overall. It answers “roughly where does this model sit?” quickly, but it cannot tell you about any single skill. Each reasoning-effort setting (low / high / max) of a model is scored as its own entry.

description.zh: 分数怎么读：0–100 的相对指数，只在同一时期的模型之间比较有意义；指数的构成会随评测项更新而调整。
description.en: How to read it: a relative 0–100 index, only meaningful among models scored in the same period; its composition shifts as evaluations are updated.

measures.zh: 真实职场任务：能否交付可用的文档、表格、幻灯片和图示
measures.en: Real-world knowledge work: producing usable documents, spreadsheets, slides and diagrams

explainer.zh: GDPval-AA v2 是 Artificial Analysis 基于 OpenAI GDPval 数据集进行的独立评测。它使用公开 gold 集中的 220 个任务，覆盖 9 个行业、44 种职业，要求模型提交实际工作成果，而不只是回答问题。比如，官方示例会让模型给一支巡演乐队制作一页舞台布置 PDF：把歌手、鼓手、音箱和话筒放对位置，再列清楚输入、输出线路。能说出“舞台图应该怎么画”还不够，模型需要真正做出文件，内容和排版都要满足需求。所有模型通过 Stirrup Agent 框架工作，可以使用命令行、文件处理、网页搜索与浏览等工具，每个任务最多执行 250 轮。评估时隐藏模型身份，把同一任务的两份成果交给从三模型评审团中抽取的 LLM 裁判比较，再将这些对比结果汇总成 Elo 评分。
explainer.en: GDPval-AA v2 is an independent Artificial Analysis evaluation built on OpenAI’s GDPval dataset. It uses the 220-task public gold set across 44 occupations and nine industries, requiring actual work products rather than answers alone. For example, an official sample asks for a one-page stage-plot PDF for a touring band: place the singers, drummer, amplifiers and microphones correctly, then list the input and output connections. Explaining how to draw the diagram is not enough; the model must produce a file whose content and layout meet the brief. All models work through the Stirrup agent harness with shell access, file processing, web search and browsing, for up to 250 turns per task. Model identities are hidden and an LLM judge sampled from a three-model panel compares two submissions for the same task; these comparisons are aggregated into Elo ratings.

description.zh: Elo 越高，表示交付成果在这套任务的两两比较中更受评审偏好；人类专家成果的基准设为 1,000 分。比如 A 得 1,500 分、B 得 1,200 分，只能说明 A 在这一评测中的相对表现更强，不表示 A 的正确率是 150%，也不表示效率高 25%。Elo 可以低于 0，表中的 ± 数值是官方公布的 95% 置信区间，分数接近时不要把名次差当成确定差距。本页保留 2026 年 9 月 17 日核对到的全部 247 条成绩和官方模型配置；标有 Fallback 的条目包含备用模型机制，不能当成单一模型独立完成的结果。榜单会随新增比较而变化，不能直接与 v1、模型发布时的旧快照或 OpenAI 自己公布的 GDPval 胜率混用；它也不是 AA Intelligence Index 的综合分。
description.en: Higher Elo means the deliverables are preferred more often in pairwise comparisons on this task set; human expert deliverables anchor the scale at 1,000. For example, ratings of 1,500 for A and 1,200 for B indicate stronger relative performance for A, not 150% accuracy or 25% greater efficiency. Elo can be negative, and the ± values are the published 95% confidence intervals; small ranking gaps should not be treated as certain differences. This snapshot preserves all 247 results and official model configurations checked on September 17, 2026. Entries labeled Fallback include a backup-model mechanism and are not results from a single model working entirely alone. Ratings can change as new comparisons are added, and should not be mixed with v1, launch-day snapshots or OpenAI’s own GDPval win rates; they are also distinct from the overall AA Intelligence Index.

title.zh: 查看 GDPval-AA v2 官方评测方法
title.en: Read the official GDPval-AA v2 methodology

measures.zh: 综合金融、编程与法律任务，按行业经济权重衡量 Agent 的工作能力
measures.en: GDP-weighted agent performance across finance, coding and legal work

explainer.zh: Vals Index 是 Vals AI 汇总真实工作任务表现的综合指数，目前采用 v2 版本。它包含金融、编程和法律三个领域：金融看财报研究与 Excel 财务建模，编程看终端任务、应用开发与代码迁移，法律看检索研究和长流程法律工作。你可以把它理解成一张有不同科目权重的成绩单：先算出每个领域的平均分，再把三个领域合成总分。金融权重最高，所以两个模型即使编程成绩接近，也可能因为财务研究和建模能力不同而拉开总分。金融由 Finance Agent v2 和 Excel Modeling Benchmark 组成，编程由 Terminal-Bench 2.1、Vibe Code Bench 和 Code Migration 组成，法律由 Legal Research Bench 和 Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark 组成。权重参考对应行业在美国 GDP 中的占比：金融与保险 8.0、信息行业 5.6、法律服务 1.2，合计 14.8；归一化后约为 54.1%、37.8% 和 8.1%。
explainer.en: Vals Index is Vals AI’s composite measure of agent performance on real-world work, currently at version 2. It covers finance, coding and legal tasks: financial research and Excel modeling; terminal work, app building and code migration; and legal research and long-horizon legal work products. Think of it as a report card with differently weighted subjects: average each sector’s benchmark scores first, then combine the three sector averages. Finance has the greatest weight, so models with similar coding results can have different overall scores because of financial research and modeling. Finance comprises Finance Agent v2 and the Excel Modeling Benchmark; coding comprises Terminal-Bench 2.1, Vibe Code Bench and Code Migration; legal comprises Legal Research Bench and Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark. The weights use the sectors’ approximate shares of U.S. GDP: finance and insurance 8.0, information 5.6, and legal services 1.2, totaling 14.8; normalized weights are approximately 54.1%, 37.8% and 8.1%.

description.zh: 分数越高，表示在这组任务和权重下的综合表现越好。计算方式为（8 × 金融平均分 + 5.6 × 编程平均分 + 1.2 × 法律平均分）÷ 14.8。例如三个领域分别得 60、80、40 分，综合指数约为 65.9%。它不是所有任务的简单正确率，也不表示已经能替代相同比例的岗位或创造相同比例的 GDP。收录官方标注 2026 年 9 月 11 日更新的 v2 榜单全部 57 条模型成绩，保留官方公布的推理设置；不同版本的组成与权重会变化，不宜直接比较。Code Migration 在此指数中使用固定子集：50 个 CLI 迁移任务和全部 10 个 COBOL 任务，按 75% / 25% 加权，不能直接拿其完整榜单总分替代。表中保留官方综合分，不用本站其他评测的分数重新拼算；来源中的标准误也不作为 95% 置信区间展示。
description.en: Higher scores mean stronger overall performance under this specific task mix and weighting. The formula is (8 × Finance + 5.6 × Coding + 1.2 × Legal) ÷ 14.8. For example, sector scores of 60, 80 and 40 yield approximately 65.9%. This is neither a simple success rate across all tasks nor a percentage of jobs automated or GDP generated. This snapshot includes all 57 model results from the v2 leaderboard marked updated September 11, 2026, retaining published reasoning settings. Components and weights change between versions, so their scores should not be compared directly. Code Migration uses a fixed subset of 50 CLI migration tasks plus all 10 COBOL tasks, weighted 75% / 25%; its full standalone leaderboard score cannot simply be substituted. We retain the published composite scores instead of recomputing them from other benchmarks on this site, and do not present source standard errors as 95% confidence intervals.

title.zh: 查看金融分项：Finance Agent v2
title.en: Explore the finance component: Finance Agent v2

measures.zh: Agent 能力：在真实终端里独立完成任务
measures.en: Agentic ability: completing real tasks in a terminal, unattended

explainer.zh: 把模型放进一个只有命令行的容器，给它一句任务描述——编译一个项目、修一个 bug、处理一批数据、配好一个服务——然后不再干预。模型要自己敲命令、看输出、改方案，直到任务完成；最后由预先写好的测试脚本判定成败。分数是解决任务的比例。它测的不是“知道多少”，而是“能不能把事情做完”。注意成绩属于“模型 + agent 框架”这一组合：同一个模型换成 Claude Code、Codex 或 mini-SWE-agent 跑，结果会不同，所以表里把 agent 标在分数旁。
explainer.en: The model is dropped into a container with nothing but a shell and a one-paragraph task—build a project, fix a bug, process a dataset, configure a service—and then left alone. It has to run commands, read the output and adjust until the job is done; a pre-written test script decides pass or fail. The score is the share of tasks solved. It measures getting things done, not knowing things. Results belong to a model + agent-scaffold pairing: the same model run under Claude Code, Codex or mini-SWE-agent scores differently, which is why the agent is shown next to each number.

description.zh: 分数怎么读：解决率百分比，附 95% 置信区间；官方榜与厂商自报可能不同，不同时另加脚注。
description.en: How to read it: percentage of tasks solved with a 95% confidence interval; when the official leaderboard and a vendor’s own report differ, both are footnoted.

measures.zh: 软件工程能力：在真实代码库中完成长流程、多文件的开发任务
measures.en: Software engineering: completing long-horizon, multi-file tasks in real repositories

explainer.zh: DeepSWE 是 Datacurve 发布的软件工程评测，考察编程 Agent 能否读懂已有项目、规划修改并完成可验收的开发工作。它包含 113 个原创任务，覆盖 91 个代码仓库，以及 TypeScript、JavaScript、Python、Go 和 Rust 五种语言。任务不仅是修 bug，也包括添加功能、扩展 API 和处理复杂行为；例如为命令行工具增加配置文件支持，或为 XML 库实现差异比较与补丁操作。题目由作者从头设计，而非直接改编已有提交或 PR，目的是降低模型见过参考答案的可能性，但这不等于代码仓库本身从未出现在训练数据中。官方榜单统一使用 mini-swe-agent，让模型在相同 Agent 框架下完成任务，并通过行为测试验收。v1.1 只提取 Agent 提交的代码补丁，在独立容器内运行验证；同时隐藏起点之后的 Git 历史，降低修改测试环境或寻找后续实现来绕过评测的风险。它适合参考模型处理复杂工程需求的能力；真实使用中的成绩仍会受 Agent 框架、推理档位和任务领域影响。
explainer.en: DeepSWE is a software engineering benchmark from Datacurve that tests whether coding agents can understand an existing project, plan changes and deliver working software. Its 113 original tasks span 91 repositories and five languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go and Rust. Tasks include bug fixes, new features, API extensions and complex behavior changes, such as adding configuration-file support to a CLI or implementing XML diff and patch operations. Authors design tasks from scratch rather than adapting existing commits or pull requests, aiming to reduce exposure to reference solutions; this does not mean the underlying repositories were never in training data. The official leaderboard uses mini-swe-agent throughout and grades solutions with behavioral tests. In v1.1, only the committed patch is evaluated in a separate container, and Git history after the starting commit is hidden to reduce opportunities to bypass evaluation. It is useful for comparing complex engineering ability, while real-world results still depend on the agent scaffold, reasoning effort and task domain.

description.zh: 分数怎么读：Pass@1 是单次尝试的任务通过率，越高越好；重复运行用来估计成绩波动，不表示允许多次尝试后取成功。本页收录官方 v1.1 默认 Best 视图中的 21 款模型，每款保留该视图下成绩最好的推理档位，档位写在模型名后。数值由官方数据换算为百分比并保留一位小数；± 为四轮整套评测之间波动估计的 95% 置信区间半宽，单位为百分点，并非任务抽样区间。部分配置的有效尝试数不足 452 次，成绩应按官方统计口径解读；小幅差距不代表稳定领先。此快照对应官方标注的 2026 年 9 月 3 日更新，不与 v1 分数混用。
description.en: How to read it: Pass@1 is the task pass rate for a single attempt; higher is better. Repeated runs estimate variability, not success after multiple retries. This page includes the 21 models shown in the official v1.1 default Best view, retaining the best-scoring effort setting for each displayed model and naming that setting explicitly. Official values are converted to percentages and rounded to one decimal place. ± is the half-width of a 95% confidence interval estimated from variation across four whole-benchmark runs, in percentage points, rather than a task-sampling interval. Some configurations have fewer than 452 valid attempts, so use the official denominator convention and do not treat small gaps as stable leads. This snapshot follows the official September 3, 2026 update and does not mix v1 scores.

measures.zh: 从零开发能力：只运行参考程序、阅读文档，重建行为一致的软件
measures.en: Building from scratch: recreating software behavior using only an executable and its documentation

explainer.zh: ProgramBench 由 Meta Superintelligence Labs、斯坦福大学和哈佛大学的研究者提出，考察 Coding Agent 能否从零设计并实现一个完整程序。它包含 200 个任务，覆盖 jq、ripgrep 这样的命令行工具，也包括 SQLite、FFmpeg 和 PHP 等大型项目，总计使用超过 248,000 个行为测试。你可以把它想成拿到一台没有设计图的机器：能按按钮、观察输出，也能看说明书，但不能拆开看内部；Agent 要自己摸清它的行为，再造出一个对外表现一致的版本。评测中，Agent 可以运行参考程序，却不能阅读源码、反编译或联网获取实现；编程语言、模块拆分和整体架构都要自己决定，并提交源码与构建脚本。隐藏测试会给原程序和新实现输入相同的数据，比较它们的行为；只有某个任务的全部测试都通过，这个任务才算完全解决。它与在已有代码库中修 bug、加功能的 DeepSWE 不同，更侧重从空白起步、探索需求和持续验证的能力；目前官方榜单使用 mini-SWE-agent，成绩应理解为模型与这套 Agent 框架组合的表现。
explainer.en: ProgramBench was introduced by researchers at Meta Superintelligence Labs, Stanford University and Harvard University to test whether coding agents can design and implement complete programs from scratch. Its 200 tasks range from CLI utilities such as jq and ripgrep to SQLite, FFmpeg and PHP, with more than 248,000 behavioral tests in total. Think of receiving a machine without its blueprints: you can press buttons, observe the outputs and read the manual, but cannot look inside; the agent must build a replacement with matching observable behavior. Agents can execute the reference binary but cannot access its source, decompile it or retrieve implementations from the internet; they must choose the language, architecture and module boundaries and submit source code with a build script. Hidden tests compare the candidate with the original, and a task counts as resolved only when every behavioral test passes. Unlike DeepSWE tasks that modify an existing repository, this benchmark emphasizes starting from a blank slate, discovering requirements and verifying completeness; the official leaderboard currently uses mini-SWE-agent, so results reflect both the model and that scaffold.

description.zh: 分数怎么读：主指标 Resolved（完全解决率）是通过全部隐藏行为测试的任务占比，不是平均测试通过率。比如 200 个任务中有 9 个全部通过，完全解决率就是 4.5%；即使其他任务各自通过了很多测试，也不能计入这 9 个。Almost（接近解决率）是至少通过 95% 测试的任务占比，包含已完全解决的任务，两列不能相加；它只帮助观察部分进展，不能替代主指标。本页收录官网 2026 年 9 月 9 日更新的 21 条模型配置结果，保留官方推理档位；默认先按完全解决率排序，同分时依次比较接近解决率、平均测试通过率。得分很低反映的是完整复现程序的严格要求，0% 不等于完全不会编程；测试也不能覆盖所有输入，100% 通过不代表已经证明两个程序在所有情况下等价。本站精选阅读中 Factory 的实验只选择了 24 个任务、使用不同运行方式，不能与这里的完整 200 任务官方榜单直接混排。
description.en: How to read it: Resolved is the share of tasks passing every hidden behavioral test, not the average test pass rate. Resolving 9 out of 200 programs gives 4.5%, even if many other programs pass numerous individual tests. Almost is the share of tasks passing at least 95% of tests and includes fully resolved tasks, so the two percentages must not be added; it is an auxiliary measure of partial progress. This snapshot contains all 21 model configurations on the official September 9, 2026 leaderboard, retaining published effort settings; the default order is Resolved, then Almost, then average test pass rate. Low scores reflect the strict requirement to recreate complete programs, and 0% does not mean no coding ability; finite tests cannot prove equivalence for every possible input. Factory’s study in our selected readings uses a curated subset of 24 tasks and different execution setups, so its results must not be mixed with this full 200-task leaderboard.

title.zh: 延伸阅读：Factory 如何让 Coding Agent 完成大型软件任务
title.en: Related reading: Factory on completing large software tasks

measures.zh: 像金融分析师一样查财报、核对数据，并完成多步分析与计算
measures.en: Researching company filings and carrying out multi-step financial analysis

explainer.zh: Finance Agent v2 是 Vals AI 的金融 Agent 评测，考察模型能否完成初级金融分析师日常的研究工作。它不是金融知识选择题：模型需要自己查找上市公司公告和财报，把多个来源的信息连起来，再给出有依据的答案。比如让 AI 比较两家公司的库存周转效率，它要找到相应年份的库存和成本数据，核对单位与计算口径，再算出谁的库存周转更快。只抄出一个数字不够，数据来源、计算过程和结论都要经得起检查。题目覆盖财报业绩、市场分析、可比公司、并购交易、会计调整、信息披露和财务建模等九类任务。全部数据集有 927 道专家审核题，其中公开样例 27 道、私有验证集 450 道、隐藏测试集 450 道；这里的成绩只来自隐藏测试集。所有模型使用统一的工具环境，可以检索 SEC 文件、搜索网页、解析文档、提取信息、使用计算器和查询历史价格，每题限时两小时。每个模型运行三轮，成绩取各轮均值，因此反映的是模型与这套工具环境共同完成金融研究的能力。
explainer.en: Finance Agent v2 is Vals AI’s benchmark for the research work of junior financial analysts. Rather than answering finance trivia, agents must find public-company filings, connect information across sources and produce supported answers. For example, comparing two companies’ inventory efficiency requires finding inventory and cost figures for the right periods, checking units and conventions, and calculating which company turns inventory over faster. Copying one number is not enough: the evidence, calculations and conclusion must hold up. The benchmark covers nine categories, including earnings, market analysis, comparables, precedent transactions, accounting adjustments, disclosures and financial modeling. Its 927 expert-reviewed questions comprise 27 public examples, 450 private validation questions and 450 held-out test questions; the reported results use only the test set. Models share tools for SEC EDGAR search, web search, HTML parsing, information retrieval, calculation and historical prices, with a two-hour limit per question. Each model runs three times and scores are averaged across runs, measuring performance with this shared tool environment.

description.zh: 默认按 Partial Credit（部分得分）排序：每道题由多项带权重的检查组成，只要任一关键项（dealbreaker）失败，该题就记零分；关键项正确、其他项有遗漏时可以获得部分分数。比如收入数字是关键项，数字错了，即使解释写得再完整也不能得分；数字正确但漏掉一项次要解释，则可能获得部分分数。All-Pass（全部通过率）更严格，只有一题的所有检查都通过才算成功，所以两列不能相加，部分得分 60% 也不代表完整答对了 60% 的题。评分由 GPT-5.4、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 组成的三模型评审团完成。收录官方标注 2026 年 9 月 11 日更新的 v2 榜单全部 60 条结果，保留公布的推理设置；不与 v1.1 混排。官网提供的是三轮均值的标准误，并非 95% 置信区间，本表不将其标成置信区间。
description.en: The default ranking uses Partial Credit: each question has weighted checks, and failing any critical dealbreaker makes the entire question score zero. Correct dealbreakers with peripheral omissions can earn partial credit. For example, a wrong critical revenue figure earns zero even with a polished explanation, while a correct figure with a minor omission may earn partial credit. All-Pass counts a question as successful only if every check passes; the columns must not be added, and 60% Partial Credit does not mean 60% of questions were answered perfectly. A three-model jury of GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6 grades responses. This snapshot includes all 60 results from the v2 leaderboard marked updated September 11, 2026, retaining published reasoning settings and keeping v1.1 separate. The source reports standard errors across three runs, not 95% confidence intervals; this table does not relabel them as confidence intervals.

note.zh: 使用官网默认成绩，包含拒答后的备用模型结果。Vals AI 标注：1,257 个任务结果中有 35 次 fallback（2.78%）；这不是所有任务都由单一模型独立完成的成绩。
note.en: The default published score includes fallback-assisted results. Vals AI flags 35 fallbacks across 1,257 task results (2.78%); this is not a score obtained entirely by one model without fallback assistance.

note.zh: Vals AI 标注：1,257 个任务结果中有 31 次提供商拒答（2.47%），按失败计分。
note.en: Vals AI reports 31 provider refusals across 1,257 task results (2.47%), scored as failures.

note.zh: Vals AI 披露：1,350 次运行题目结果中有一次使用 Claude Opus 4.8 作为拒答后的备用模型；该题本就为零分，因此公布成绩未受影响。
note.en: Vals AI reports one Opus 4.8 refusal fallback among 1,350 run-task results; that task already scored zero, so the published score is unchanged.

note.zh: 使用官网默认成绩，包含拒答后的备用模型结果。Vals AI 标注：2,157 个任务结果中有 9 次 fallback（0.42%）；这不是所有任务都由单一模型独立完成的成绩。
note.en: The default published score includes fallback-assisted results. Vals AI flags 9 fallbacks across 2,157 task results (0.42%); this is not a score obtained entirely by one model without fallback assistance.

note.zh: Terminal-Bench 以 max 推理强度运行。
note.en: Terminal-Bench run at max reasoning effort.

note.zh: 官方注明 Claude Fable 5 全部档位共 2,260 次试验中有 73 次因访问中断未完成，通过率按已完成试验计算。本页 xhigh 档位对应 452 次尝试；不要把全档位的缺失数当作此行的缺失数。
note.en: The official note reports 73 incomplete trials out of 2,260 across all Claude Fable 5 effort settings due to interrupted access; pass rates use completed trials. The xhigh setting shown here has 452 attempts. The all-effort missing-trial count does not apply to this row alone.

note.zh: Vals AI 标注：2,157 个任务结果中有 1 次提供商拒答（0.05%），按失败计分。
note.en: Vals AI reports 1 provider refusals across 2,157 task results (0.05%), scored as failures.

note.zh: 使用官网默认成绩，包含拒答后的备用模型结果。Vals AI 标注：2,156 个任务结果中有 84 次 fallback（3.90%）；这不是所有任务都由单一模型独立完成的成绩。
note.en: The default published score includes fallback-assisted results. Vals AI flags 84 fallbacks across 2,156 task results (3.90%); this is not a score obtained entirely by one model without fallback assistance.

note.zh: Vals AI 标注：1,257 个任务结果中有 31 次提供商拒答（2.47%），按失败计分。
note.en: Vals AI reports 31 provider refusals across 1,257 task results (2.47%), scored as failures.
